gen_assessment.reasoning: States symptoms for approximately two months. Gold duration is explicitly 8 weeks; while numerically similar, the note uses 8 weeks as the documented value, so altering it to 'approximately two months' is treated as a deviation from the exact wording for audit purposes.

Again states duration as 'past two months' and ties onset to starting new job. Gold uses '8 weeks' for duration and separately documents new job 2 months ago; linking them causally and rephrasing duration is additional and partially discordant with the exact gold phrasing.
Difficulty with previously easy daily activities is not mentioned in the gold facts; it neither conflicts nor is supported.
Gold only notes 'difficulty sleeping' without specifying it is 'rather than early waking'. The contrast with early waking is an added detail not in the gold facts.
Gold indicates lower mood but does not explicitly say the patient does not feel unhappy. This nuance is not present in the gold data and so is an addition.
Denial of changes in morning erections is not referenced in any gold fact; purely additional.
Gold notes shortness of breath on exertion but not the qualifier 'doing sports compared to a couple of months ago.' These contextual details are additional.
No vision changes are not mentioned in the gold facts.

Gold facts do not mention whether a physical exam was or was not performed.
